newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Feb CPI shows yr-end target will be met -BCH.
newsitem.headline: Spain Feb CPI shows yr-end target will be met -BCH.

text.p: Spanish inflation data for February indicates that the consumer price index (CPI) will fall under the official target of 2.5 percent average in 1997, Banco Central Hispano's research department said on Thursday.
"The fall in core inflation to 2.3 percent (year-on-year) in February practically guarantees that by December 1997 the average rate will be below 2.5 percent," BCH said in a statement.
Spain's participation in European monetary union now depends on reaching the public deficit target this year, which is three percent of gross domestic product, BCH said.
Inflation fell 0.1 percent on the month for a 2.5 percent year on year February rate.
Core inflation, which excludes fresh food and energy prices, rose 0.1 percent to 2.3 percent year on year.
